en.stem_md: The water level height (m) at time $t$ hours is modelled by $h(t)=17+3\sin\frac{\pi t}{6}$. Find the height at $t=7$ h.
en.mistake_note_md: Confusing amplitude (range $2A$) with the maximum, or substituting the sine argument ($\frac{\pi t}{6}$) incorrectly.
